tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build example
args: $idfRoot = '${config:idf.espIdfPathWin}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($idfRoot) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $idfRoot 'export.ps1'))) { $idfRoot = $env:IDF_PATH }; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($idfRoot) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $idfRoot 'export.ps1'))) { throw 'ESP-IDF is not configured. Run ESP-IDF: Configure ESP-IDF extension first.' }; . (Join-Path $idfRoot 'export.ps1'); & '${workspaceFolder}\build.ps1' -HardwareVersion '${input:hardware}' -Example '${input:example}' -Action 'build'
